defaults.apiKeys: sandbox public and private API keys
notes: In test mode the CVC is not strictly validated when tokenizing.

If you tokenize 4111111111111111 or any valid card and create a charge within 10 minutes, the transaction succeeds; after 10 minutes the API returns 'El tiempo de espera desde la captura de datos de la tarjeta expiró. Intenta de nuevo.'
Sandbox: if customer information is not added, it is sent as null.

Success test tokens: tok_test_visa_4242, tok_test_visa_1881, tok_test_mastercard_4444, tok_test_mastercard_5100, tok_test_amex_0005, tok_test_amex_8431, tok_test_amex_0006, tok_test_banorte_debit, tok_test_banco_azteca_debit.

fields.note: Error row for a monthly-installments (MSI) attempt sent without CVC; using token tok_test_msi_error returns the token-capture timeout message.

declineCodes.officialMeaning: The card does not have enough funds; use another payment method or wait for available balance.
Card declined for unknown reasons (may also occur if the card was issued outside Mexico); buyer should contact the issuer.
The expiry month is incorrect (e.g. 14 or 15); retry with a valid expiry date.
The expiry year is incorrect (e.g. 1999 or 2145); retry with a valid expiry date.
The CVC is invalid or incorrect; tokenize the card again with the correct CVC.
The card was reported lost or stolen; do not disclose to the customer.
The card has expired; retry with a valid card.
The card lacks sufficient credit limit; retry with a valid card with sufficient funds.
Payment declined by fraud prevention; avoid giving the customer further details.
The card is blocked for payments through Conekta; tokenize a new card with correct data.
The card exceeded the charge attempt limit; retry with a card that has not exceeded it.
The card exceeded the allowed amount limit; retry with a card that does not exceed it.
The card has expired and is no longer valid; try a valid card.
The card cannot make payments; buyer should contact the issuing bank.
CVC was not sent on a monthly-installments (MSI) payment attempt; tokenize again including the CVC.

gaps: Only 15 card error names are documented on the test-cards page; the 'Consulta más códigos de error de Direct API' link (https://developers.conekta.com/v2.3.0/reference/errores) was not read.

The codes above are the names in the 'Error' column of the test table. The docs do not state which API response field carries them (e.g. details[].code vs a namespaced code like conekta.errors.*); verify against a real sandbox response before matching on them.
'tok_test_msi_error' is listed in the Error column but reads like a test token name, not an error code; included literally with that caveat.
No email, amount, or document rules are stated for card tests; 'any future date' has no concrete example.
The 3DS test cards page (https://developers.conekta.com/docs/activar-3d-secure-2) was not read.

https://developers.conekta.com/docs/errores-2 turned out to cover cash payouts (Retiros), not card charges; only its error 'type' table (api_error 500, processing_error 402, parameter_validation_error 422, ...) is generic and was not used for card decline codes.
retryable false only where docs say to retry with a different/valid card; Category mapping is our own classification.
